definitions.explanation: Continuing in an unbroken line over a long time; said of traditions, families, lineages and history. Usually {連綿|れんめん}と before a verb.

examples.japanese: ⟦{伝統|でんとう}→伝統：09585_dentou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{連綿|れんめん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
{連綿|れんめん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{受|う}け{継|つ}がれて→受け継ぐ：06700_uketsugu⟧きた⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧。
examples.english: Skills handed down without a break.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{江戸時代|えどじだい}→江戸時代：20431_edojidai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{連綿|れんめん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦{酒蔵|さかぐら}→酒蔵：08633_sakagura⟧で、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{酒|さけ}→酒：02211_sake⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{造|つく}っている→造る：17751_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: This family has run a sake brewery without a break since the Edo period and still makes sake the old way.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- {連綿|れんめん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧: to continue unbroken
- {連綿|れんめん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{受|う}け{継|つ}がれる→受け継ぐ：06700_uketsugu⟧: to be handed down from generation to generation
- {連綿|れんめん}たる + noun: unbroken ~ (written)

REGISTER:
Formal and mostly written: speeches, histories, company and shrine histories. In conversation ⟦ずっと→ずっと：00912_zutto⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧ says the same thing plainly.
